comment: 44yo female, recently confirmed germline ATM c.7271T>G (p.Val2424Gly) pathogenic variant on multi-gene HBOC panel after first-degree relative (father) diagnosed with pancreatic adenocarcinoma at age 58. No personal cancer. ATM heterozygous carriers: lifetime breast cancer ~20-30% (RR ~2.0-2.4), PDAC lifetime ~5-9% (RR ~5-10 in FDR-of-PDAC cohorts), modest prostate enrichment for males. Fires RF-ATM-CONFIRMED-CARRIER (relevant_diseases: breast, PDAC, prostate). Engine routes to PreventionPlan: default = IND-ATM-CARRIER-PREVENTION-SURVEILLANCE (annual mammography from age 40 + MRI consideration + EUS/MR-pancreas alternating annually from age 50 or 10 years before earliest PDAC in family per CAPS Consortium 2022); alternative = IND-ATM-CARRIER-PREVENTION-OBSERVATION (cascade testing + symptom-driven workup, declining intensified surveillance).
